items.heading: Palusami
details: Key ingredients: taro leaves, coconut cream, onion
Layer taro leaves with chopped onion.
Pour coconut cream over the layered leaves.
Wrap tightly in foil or more taro leaves.
Bake or steam until the leaves are tender and the cream has thickened.

items.heading: Coconut Fish
details: Key ingredients: reef fish, coconut cream, lime, onion
Dice raw fish and marinate briefly in lime juice.
Mix in coconut cream and finely diced onion.
Chill the mixture so the flavors meld.
Serve cold as a refreshing island dish.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
